provenance: Frozen self-contained current-production adapter; archived provider events and validated replayCheckpoints. Synthetic scenarios are separate from historical evidence. Every scoring state, 21 evenly spaced checkpoints and final ten plays are sampled; peaks are sampled checkpoint peaks.

namedExamples.explanation: Buffalo Bills lead 13–7 with 6:37 left in the second quarter. Ravens' Lamar Jackson is out for the game with thumb injury suffered on 1st play. Joe Fagnano has thrown passes since Lamar Jackson's departure.

developments.evidenceText: Ravens' Lamar Jackson out for game with thumb injury suffered on 1st play. Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Bills with a right thumb injury.
